package.name: policy_runner
package.description: web_monitor: subscribes camera images + joint_states over ROS2 (rclpy) and serves a browser page showing which streams are live, adapted from trajectory_recorder's capture console minus the recording pipeline. act_infer_mujoco: runs ACT inference on those same live camera/joint topics at a fixed rate and writes the resulting action straight into a MuJoCo model's qpos for visualization (no actuators/mj_step, no UDP output to the real robot yet) -- see repo README.
